##### Project general facts

Olivia Residences is a contemporary residential development by Karma Developers, presented by Deca. The building offers a selection of one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments with spacious floor plans, designed to provide a comfortable residential environment with views of the surrounding greenery. Located adjacent to The Greens community within Dubai Investment Park, the development offers a family-oriented setting surrounded by landscaped areas.

The development provides a range of amenities focused on leisure, wellness, and everyday comfort. Residents can enjoy an infinity pool, kids’ pool, indoor gym, meditation area, sauna, Zen Garden, and outdoor cinema. The project is also located within walking distance of schools, with metro stations nearby and hospitals and supermarkets just minutes away, providing convenient access to essential facilities and services.

The apartments feature modern finishes made with high-quality materials and are delivered semi-furnished. Kitchen appliances are provided, creating a practical and comfortable living environment. The development also offers an interest-free payment plan, providing an additional purchasing option for both end-users and investors.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Investment Park is a strategically planned integrated community in Dubai that combines industrial, commercial, and residential areas. Spanning more than 2,300 hectares, the district offers comprehensive infrastructure and a wide range of facilities supporting both business and residential needs. Its location near major transportation routes also contributes to its role as an established business and investment destination.

The area hosts a diverse range of industries, including manufacturing, logistics, technology, and services. Its modern infrastructure and convenient location provide access to major business destinations, while the growing number of residential developments contributes to a dynamic urban environment. The community also offers essential amenities and services for residents and businesses.

Dubai Investment Park places a strong emphasis on sustainability and green spaces, with parks, landscaped gardens, and recreational facilities integrated throughout the community. Its proximity to major highways and transportation networks provides convenient connectivity to other parts of Dubai, allowing residents to access key destinations while enjoying a balanced environment combining urban infrastructure and green surroundings.
